introHtml: For safety managers and HR directors, choosing flame resistant products means prioritizing worker protection in environments with arc flash, flash fire, or combustible dust hazards. Unlike standard promotional items, these products are engineered to self-extinguish and reduce burn injury severity. Options include FR-rated apparel, welding caps, and high-visibility vests that meet NFPA 70E or ASTM F1506 standards. Decoration methods like screen printing or heat transfer are compatible with FR fabrics, ensuring your company logo remains visible without compromising safety compliance.
heroAltText: Custom flame resistant products including FR-rated safety vests and apparel with company logo for workplace safety
